newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius share index marginally up, volume lower.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius share index marginally up, volume lower.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Mauritius share index, Semdex, edged up by 0.17 points to 363.77 on Friday, reflecting price rises of smaller listed companies.
Turnover was posted at 16.11 million rupees on 732,884 shares from 25.86 million rupees on 1,290,351 shares on Wednesday.
Brokers attributed the little changed semdex on stable prices among leading listed shares. "It's rather the shares of the smaller companies which pushed up the semdex," one said.
Key stocks were mixed with trading volume seen fairly spread across the board.
Mauritius Commercial Bank was unchanged at 82 rupees on 16,174 shares and State Bank of Mauritius remained at 11 rupees on 285,495 shares.
Swan Insurance surged 2.50 rupees to 48 on 57,447 shares and building materials manufacturer United Basalt Products was 20 cents up to 36.70 rupees on 58,464 shares.
Rogers was stable at 97.50 rupees on 10,949 shares and Ireland Blyth fell 70 cents to 14.50 rupees on 10,000 shares.
Commerce-based Courts was 30 cents higher at 6.70 rupees on 28,575 shares and Happy World Foods gained 10 cents to 17.10 rupees on 11,330 shares.
In the hotel sector, New Mauritius Hotels rose 20 cents to 32.20 rupees on 50,000 shares and Sun Resorts lost 30 cents to 39.80 rupees on 11,490 shares.
National carrier Air Mauritius was unchanged at 43.50 rupees on 11,660 shares.
